name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text:
Fork the **Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** into our repo and rename it to avoid confusion with upstream changes. This gives us full control to modify prompts, engines, and routing for our specific needs without waiting for upstream updates.

Trade-off: We accept the maintenance burden of merging upstream changes ourselves, but gain the ability to iterate faster on self-improvement without external dependencies blocking progress.

name: Gauge
text: Forking locks us into a snapshot that may rot—our workflows evolve faster than upstream. Instead, cherry-pick only the skills we need and patch them in place; this keeps us current while avoiding the dead weight of a full fork. Settle it by proving the forked pack’s prompts or engines are already out of sync with upstream.
